# Commit ids in the public copy

The public copy of this repository was made by rewriting the messages and the author or committer addresses of some
commits, with trees and commit dates unchanged, so a rewritten commit and every commit built on it has a new id. This
table maps each commit id cited in the repository's Markdown files to its id in the copy; "not published" marks a
commit that is on no published branch. The rows were generated from the rewrite's id log, and the publication checks
every row: the commit in the working repository and the commit in the copy have the same tree.
